scope: Actual WITHOUT ROWID SQL and primary-key-first index records, secondary primary-key locators, actual automatic-index numbering, public/private names, connection registers, transactions and independently observed rollback/WAL files. Finite admitted cases; not global SQLite equivalence.

negative_results.reason: WITHOUT ROWID construction and native-origin roots were unsupported.
The actual IO file-open route reads primary-key-first records; writing, secondary locators and implicit rowid visibility still fail.
Private point predicates and secondary indexes still follow rowid assumptions.
Private UPDATE/DELETE captured predicates were accidentally subjected to public implicit-rowid rejection.
All original 72 pass. Real columns shadowing all three rowid names and actual INTEGER-PK automatic-index numbering expose two remaining failure pairs.
Changing private captures to the hidden ordinal name also sent that name through public INSERT target binding. The actual WITHOUT ROWID candidate must contain only declared targets.
REPLACE still demanded an ordinary SQL rowid register. WITHOUT ROWID replacement must preserve actual primary fields and omit that ordinary-rowid freezing step.

implementation: Concrete AST/token certificates retain actual WITHOUT ROWID and STRICT options. Source-aware construction validates mandatory PK, NOT NULL, AUTOINCREMENT rejection and declared metadata, then retains the real declaration and constraint programs.

CoreWithoutRowidData derives PK-first storage columns from the source; generic physical index traversal preserves interior promoted records and overflow payloads. Real IO file/WAL acquisition dispatches by actual declaration storage kind. Public row-table fast opens decline WITHOUT ROWID before acquiring that component certificate.

Logical private ordinals remain stable during a statement and normalize to actual PK order only at the outer boundary. They are absent from physical table/index records. Public expression contexts resolve only declared columns, including real rowid/oid/_rowid_ names; private projections use an explicit internal context. INSERT candidates omit the private column entirely.

Secondary index records contain actual key-program values plus missing primary-key columns, with column/collation-based suppression. Independent acquisition checks every field with only column read affinity; comparison collation never hides different stored bytes.

The virtual primary constraint has no separate sqlite_schema index row. Automatic numbering handles SQLite's late INTEGER-PK conversion, and metadata uses actual origin/order/collations. Source programs continue to enforce actual PK/UNIQUE conflicts and replacement victims.

The pure source-aware decodeForOpen counterparts now appear explicitly in checked-image/applied-write/journal-recovery contracts. Historical row-table component decoders/inverses remain separate. The C VFS shim is unchanged.

evaluation_protocols.public_file_modes: 7808 full stdout/exit/first-error and independent persisted-state comparisons, including 104 WITHOUT ROWID cases with fresh values and both public file modes. The new helper snapshots catalog, table declarations, every declared stored value with type/quote/hex and native integrity; it does not assume SELECT rowid is valid.
evaluation_protocols.same_connection: 348 actual continuing Core API cases, including 32 WITHOUT ROWID insertion/change counters, conflict errors, ABORT continuation, programs and RETURNING cases. These are reported separately from public file comparisons.
evaluation_protocols.component_controls: Four earlier metadata-fed pure/IO root-decoder controls use captured file bytes and SQLite-supplied catalog SQL/root. These are component diagnostics, not public-open or actual VFS acquisition results.
evaluation_protocols.crashes: 492 finite SIGKILL timing samples, including 24 WITHOUT ROWID samples. Actual production recovery is followed by independent SQLite typed values, catalog, integrity, indexed-key query and schema-cookie observations. No every-syscall/power-loss/arbitrary-schedule claim.
evaluation_protocols.named_features: All 88 original named probes pass on fresh values; the previous two WITHOUT ROWID probe failures disappear. A probe pass is not complete coverage of its named feature, and 88/88 is not a global compatibility percentage.

proof_scope: The complete build, 412 maintained Lean groups and required audits pass. Context.column?_public proves the actual context resolves only declared names when implicit aliases and private projection are disabled. The new maintained group checks PK-first column permutation, no ordinal in physical records, actual secondary suppression, replacement victims, last_insert_rowid and all-three-name shadowing. Checked-image decode and recovery use source-aware acquisition explicitly; no global SQL/WITHOUT ROWID/planner equivalence theorem is claimed.
limitations: Descending and repeated primary-key/collation combinations, non-ABORT declaration policies, UTF-16 WITHOUT ROWID acquisition/writes, auxiliary foreign-parent/planner admission, recursive auxiliary REPLACE with DELETE programs, ALTER/UPSERT and wider expression/phase combinations remain work.
Bulk physical root-page layout is not globally SQLite-identical; pending new-object schema metadata and larger root-preservation cases remain separate work.
Wider error codes/phases, FAIL/IGNORE/ROLLBACK controls, triggered UPSERT, INSTEAD OF/temp triggers, writable CTEs, trigger-aware ALTER and deferred private-function declarations remain work.

UTF-16 writes/setters, native-key/materialization limits, pending new physical allocations and earlier SQL/storage limitations remain. The finite process-kill samples do not establish every syscall/power-loss schedule.
